description: Phase 3b step 7 (build plan §6.8): two new, empty, club-owned tables with row-level security: a guardian's request to delete a child's information waiting for the club, and anonymous payment records kept after a child is deleted. Nothing existing is altered. Additive: no row, account, email, phone, session, role or membership may change. Rehearsal on a Neon branch of production, so nothing is volatile.
